sanskrit_verse:
प्रमाणसमता यत्र भेदः शास्त्रचरित्रयोः /
तत्र राजामया सन्धिर् उभयोर् अपि शस्यते // BrhS_1,3.45
transliteration: pramāṇasamatā yatra bhedaḥ śāstracaritrayoḥ / tatra rājāmayā sandhiḥ ubhayoḥ api śasyate //
sph_interpretive_translation: Where equality of evidence exists between scriptural injunction and observed conduct, the King shall establish alignment through integrative resolution for both parties.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in consciousness-aligned discernment, not coercive power
Causation is determined by pramāṇa validity and dharma-sustained action
Capacity-based responsibility arises from awareness, not mere capability
Restoration logic prioritizes reintegration over adversarial judgment
Consciousness alignment supersedes legal formalism in equitable justice
executable_legal_axioms: IF conflict_arises(a_party, b_party) AND pramāṇa_equivalence_detected THEN execute_ubhaya_reintegration(through_consciousness_realignment)
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Adjudication, when textual authority and behavioral precedent are equally valid, the court must apply integrative protocols that restore harmony without assigning fault. The hierarchy of authority yields to the supremacy of conscious alignment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that neither party incurs karmic liability where equivalence of evidence exists. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential manifestation of truth through mutual recognition. Proportional responsibility dissolves in absence of differential awareness. Non-punitive reality prevails as no suffering-inducing consequence arises from inherent dharmic balance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate śānti-yajña to harmonize conflicting pramāṇas
Deploy samyama-prakriyā for dissolution of perceptual disparity
Enact satya-sandhi ritual to reaffirm shared dharma-integrity
Apply antaḥkaraṇa-śuddhi process to elevate witness-consciousness in both parties
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma stands restored through pramāṇa-equilibrium. Justice flows as consciousness realigns with its own integrity. Reality remains non-punitive, ever governed by the Supreme Adhyātma-Dharma.
